plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, remembers Elizabeth Targ, the daughter of Russell Targ, as a psychiatrist doing brilliant medical research on psychic healers. As the story goes, she died in 2002 of glioblastoma, a deadly brain cancer, the very illness she had been studying with those healers, a sad and striking twist for someone testing whether healing at a distance works.
